summary: Drop omni_search v5–v8 on or after 2026-11-12 if the 7-day delta shows zero calls?
question: Drop omni_search v5–v8 on or after 2026-11-12 if the 7-day delta shows zero calls?

options.label: Track function calls, then drop
options.what: Turn on `track_functions=all` now. Drop on or after max(11-12 16:00, tracking on + 7 days) if the verify query returns `go=true`.
options.risk: Lowest: both REST and GraphQL are checked. The drop slips about 1 day.

options.label: Drop on 11-12 on current evidence
options.what: Drop on 11-12 using `pgss_delta` and the code audit only.
options.risk: GraphQL callers go unseen. A ≤2.3.3 install not opened since about June fails one search.

options.label: Don't drop
options.what: Don't drop. Ship only the mobile/depot cleanup.
options.risk: Keeps 4 slow functions anyone with the anon key can call (v7 ~12 s cold).

on_accept: `supabase db push` the tracking migration only, from a clean main.
On the window date, run `q.sh shoplocal "$(cat scripts/perf/verify-omni-v5-v8-unused.sql)"`.
If `go=true`: merge the mobile branch, push the drop migration, regenerate web-app types, re-measure. If not: no drop, and I report the caller.
